mod.overview: Thieves Mod (Revelation) v1.1b is a class-based Tribes 1.50 total-conversion mod by p|DGE0n and PheoniX that replaces standard Shifter/base armors with eight specialized combat and infiltration archetypes. Compared to Shifter's wide vehicle and heavy-armor sandbox, Thieves strips out Shifter's extra armors and custom flyers in favor of tight class counters, personal stealth warps, status-effect weapons (energy-draining EMP shells, nanite DoT bolts, gravity pull/push beams, and a Dimensional Rifter that banishes victims to Purgatory), and dramatic base-building deployables. Matches revolve around Infiltrators and Murderers bypassing defenses, Snipers piloting transports and picking off targets with Railguns, Kamikazes planting timed TNT nukes, and Engineers or Mercenaries erecting Teleport Pads, Shield Generators, force-field bunkers, and the R. B. O. deployable forward base.
notes: Classes and roles (8 armors): Infiltrator (fast stealth saboteur, max 2 weapons, hidden from sensors, passes enemy force fields, Beacons become 3-use personal warps, cannot carry flags or pilot vehicles); Sniper (LightArmor, max 3 weapons, sole vehicle pilot, Railgun and Nanite Burst Rifle); Psycho (SoldierArmor, max 4 weapons, Disruptor Cannon, ATC, Intercooler Pack, melee slap on enemy contact); Mercenary (MediumArmor, max 4 weapons, Blast Cannon, GravGun/AntiGravGun, P. D. S., and R. B. O.); Kamikaze (AvengerArmor, max 4 weapons, energy/plasma/laser resistant, TNT Pack, Beacons deploy PhaseLok missile turrets); Murderer (PredatorArmor, max 4 weapons, hidden from sensors and auto-fades out at stations, immune to Dimensional Rifter purgatory); Engineer (HeavyArmor, max 5 weapons, Incinerator, Minion, ATC, force fields, blast doors, platforms, Rocket Turret, Shield Generator, partial headshot protection); Tank (DreadnaughtArmor, max 5 weapons, 1.40 health, extreme bullet/explosive resistance, Heavy ATC, Heavy Blast Cannon, Dimensional Rifter).

Spawns, menus, and controls: Players spawn in LightArmor (Sniper) with Blaster, Chaingun, Disclauncher, and RepairKit. After picking a team, a custom menu lets players choose between their personal skin or the team default skin. Laser Rifle requires an Energy Pack equipped to fire; no custom chat commands are added.

Unique combat and status effects: Dimensional Rifter and Rift Mines teleport victims to an isolated Purgatory room for 7 seconds (21s cooldown, Murderer immune); Disruptor Cannon zeroes energy and suspends recharge; Nanite Burst Rifle inflicts a ticking DoT; GravGun/AntiGravGun pull or push players (reduced knockback vs Tank); Psycho deals 0.20 crush damage on close-range forward contact; HyperBlaster is available to every class except Tank.

Deployables and forward bases: Engineers and Mercenaries can build skybridges and forward bases using Deployable Platforms (team max 15), Small/Large Force Fields (4/2), Blast Doors (4), Rocket Turrets (10), P. D. S. jump pads (3, with rare orbital mega-launches), Teleport Pads (3, telefrags exits, blocks flags and heavy/tank armors), Shield Generators (2), and the R. B. O. (1), which constructs a Generator, Inventory Station, Command Station, two Ammo Stations, and a Pulse Sensor over 15 seconds.

Station rules and explicit bans: $RemoteInvList disables buying DShieldPack, BaseOpsPack (R. B. O.), and TNTPak from remote inventory stations (must be bought at a main Inventory Station). Other deployable caps include PhaseLokAmmo (5), TurretPack (10), DeployableInvPack (5), DeployableAmmoPack (7), CameraPack (15), PulseSensorPack (15), MotionSensorPack (15), DeployableSensorJammerPack (8), Beacon (40), and mineammo (35).
Vehicles and AI bots: Standard Scout (team max 3), LAPC (2), and HAPC (1) vehicles remain available, but only Sniper (LightArmor) can pilot them. Base AI bot helper support is retained in ai.cs.
Additional station and team bans: Blocked at Remote Stations ($RemoteInvList = 0): BaseOpsPack (TrItem.cs), DShieldPack (TrItem.cs), TNTPak (TrItem.cs).
